title: markitai batch index (markitai.index.json), schema version 1
description: The items of a batch converted with --format json -o DIR. Every listed key is always present; null means not applicable. Later 1.x versions only add keys.

source.description: The item as the batch report names it (a path relative to the input folder, or a URL).

document.description: The item's document JSON, relative to the index.

markdown.description: The Markdown the JSON sits beside, relative to the index.
